Changes: medium-voltage grid 459_0 and its medium-voltage resource rows extracted from the country-wide tables; GeoJSON converted to tabular form; the normalised demand profile multiplied by the nodal peak as the paper prescribes; no gap filling, no unit conversion beyond kW to MW where stated.
content: medium-voltage grid nodes: peak demand, coordinates, base-case voltage

units.base_case_voltage_pu: per unit, the source's own power-flow solution

voltage_limits: NOT SUPPLIED by the source. Every vendored case in this repository carries per-bus limits and this grid does not, so a band has to be declared before the market can run on it (§14).
peak_mw_unit_evidence: summed downstream peak_mw divided by (base_case_flow x s_nom_mva) is the power factor of that flow, and it lands in [0.90001, 0.98927] on all 128 edges. That is what ties peak_mw in MW to s_nom in MVA.
demand_power_factor_evidence: the minimum of that quotient is exactly 0.90001, reached on the most heavily loaded edges where line charging matters least; values above it are cable runs whose charging offsets reactive demand. This supplies phi_n of §3.1 as tan(arccos(0.9)) = 0.4843 from the data rather than as a declared parameter.
